conclusion: In this lexical (word-overlap) cache simulation on 60 hand-made pairs, a 0.80 threshold reused answers for 50% of questions but 6 of 30 reuses were wrong, no threshold from 0.70 to 0.98 reached zero wrong reuses (3 of the 3 wrong reuses at 0.96 are same-words-different-order pairs this bag-of-words vector cannot separate by construction), and skipping time-sensitive or personal questions plus matching numbers and names still let some wrong reuses through.
setup: 60 labeled pairs (30 paraphrase, 30 look-alike, 3 of them order-only); lexical vector = bag of hashed words + char trigrams (dim 1024, trigram weight 0.25) with a 35-word hand-written synonym table, no neural model; cache = 60 real rows + 10000 seeded random unit vectors as synthetic scan workload; thresholds 0.7 to 0.98 step 0.02; model call 900 ms is a hypothetical baseline, not measured; seed 20
